verdict.rationale: Luma's API platform lets users create and manage API keys, and keys can be named (e.g. production, staging). However, multiple keys share quota, and nothing documents per-key permission scopes, endpoint restrictions or least-privilege limits. Named keys without scoping are an adjacent feature, not scoped credentials, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
